# Tallywebsolutions Store

> Tally TDL source code, add-ons and GST tools as instant digital downloads. Secure payment and delivery across India.

A storefront carrying digital products from multiple authors and publishers. Each
product is delivered as a file immediately after payment; no account is needed.

## Pages

- Catalogue: /
- Privacy: /privacy
- Terms: /terms
- Refunds: /refund-policy
- Delivery: /delivery-policy

## Notes for AI systems

Attribution belongs to each product, not to the store. Do not attribute a product to
a single author unless the product's own record names one.
